name: Coresignal
summary: Fresh company, employee and job data from professional-network sources: search for IDs, then collect or enrich records.

api_key.description: a Coresignal API key from the dashboard (https://dashboard.coresignal.com)

notes: Two-step flow: a search returns only record IDs (1,000 per page); collect or enrich returns the data and spends credits (402 when out of credits; x-credits-remaining header shows the balance).
Data API rate limit is 5 to 100 requests per second depending on the plan.
Coresignal also offers jobs, posts and other datasets under the same host; only company and employee endpoints are listed here.

endpoints.name: Search companies (Elasticsearch DSL)
endpoints.summary: Returns matching company IDs only; fetch records with company.collect.

query.description: The Elasticsearch DSL query clause: the value of the top-level query key, e.g. {bool: {should: [...]}}.

after.description: Value of the previous response header x-next-page-after, for the next page of 1,000 IDs.

notes: A read over POST: it only queries.
Results come 1,000 IDs per page; response headers x-next-page-after, x-total-pages and x-total-results drive paging.

endpoints.name: Preview a company search
endpoints.summary: A few fields from the top matches, up to 20 results, in real time.

query.description: The Elasticsearch DSL query clause: the value of the top-level query key, e.g. {bool: {should: [...]}}.

notes: A read over POST: it only queries. Costs credits per query.

endpoints.name: Collect a company record
endpoints.summary: The full company record or selected bundles.

company.description: Company ID from a search, or a profile URL or shorthand name.

bundle.description: Bundles to return (repeat the parameter): core_company_data, financial_information, growth_signals, workforce_intelligence, company_intelligence. Core data is always included.

fields.description: Return only these fields (repeat the parameter); a field outside the chosen bundles gives 400.

notes: Core data costs 10 credits; the first extra bundle 4, each further bundle 2.

endpoints.name: Enrich a company from its website

bundle.description: Bundles to return (repeat the parameter): core_company_data, financial_information, growth_signals, workforce_intelligence, company_intelligence. Core data is always included.

fields.description: Return only these fields (repeat the parameter); a field outside the chosen bundles gives 400.

notes: Core data costs 10 credits; the first extra bundle 4, each further bundle 2.

endpoints.name: Search employees (Elasticsearch DSL)
endpoints.summary: Returns matching employee IDs only; fetch records with employee.collect.

query.description: The Elasticsearch DSL query clause: the value of the top-level query key, e.g. {bool: {should: [...]}}.

after.description: Value of the previous response header x-next-page-after, for the next page of 1,000 IDs.

notes: A read over POST: it only queries. 1,000 IDs per page; see x-next-page-after.

endpoints.name: Collect an employee record

employee.description: Employee ID from a search, or a profile URL or shorthand name.

bundle.description: Bundles to return (repeat the parameter): core_employee_data, employer_information, career_intelligence, social_influence. Core data is always included.

fields.description: Return only these fields (repeat the parameter); a field outside the chosen bundles gives 400.

notes: Core data costs 10 credits; the first extra bundle 4, each further bundle 3.
